historical_record.description: A building contract was recorded for the same plumbing, for an apartment building, with C. M. Cook named as architect.

Sold for $200,000, deed recorded July 31, 1969. The Redevelopment Agency's appraisers, filing it in their Western Addition market data, described a three and a half story dwelling with a full basement, used as 18 apartments, 42 rooms, built about 1913, 9,425 sq ft.

In the Redevelopment Agency's 1962 acquisition appraisal for Western Addition A-2, the appraiser Maury Holmes put the market value of this property and the two-story frame and stucco building of six apartments next door at 2231 O'Farrell, together at $165,000, rating them in fair-to-good condition. He described this one as a three-story frame and stucco building of fifteen apartments (2201 O'Farrell), with a one-room penthouse apartment and two basement apartments.
